$comment: Source -> dist/skills/ artifact mapping, applied in order by assemble.mjs (later entries layer onto earlier copies). Skills are flat siblings — clients discover <skills-dir>/<name>/SKILL.md one level deep. Regenerate with `node packages/mdk-skill/src/assemble.mjs`; never hand-edit dist/.

entries.note: Hand-authored suite content: router + mdk-worker, mdk-app-routes, mdk-create-app, mdk-app-rbac, mdk-ui-component, mdk-deployment, mdk-site-sizing, mdk-publish-security, mdk-worker-security, mdk-app-security (full workflows). One folder in this tree is generated, not hand-authored: skills/mdk-ui-component/references/ui-registry/ is ui/packages/react-devkit/dist/registry.json split into an index plus one file per entry by docs/scripts/sync-ui-registry.mjs. Regenerate it with `npm run generate:ui-registry` from the repo root; never hand-edit it. mdk-site-sizing/references/envelope.json is compiled from eval/profiles (or harness results) by skills/mdk-site-sizing/scripts/compile-envelope.mjs.
